messages.subject: Unhandled Exception: No such id
parts:
Hi, what does it mean when I get an error "Unhandled Exception: No such id"?

[2014-08-05T23:02:29.951003703+0000] Copying file ui.R
[2014-08-05T23:02:29.962070191+0000] Copying file styles.css
[2014-08-05T23:02:29.972843537+0000] Copying file server.R
[2014-08-05T23:02:29.982684552+0000] Copying file .DS_Store
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 813700 error: Unhandled Exception: No such id: 0b8a81e3c48b360eb73d80083d95bee21f488aee5ac61665e27be422c21e1def
Execution halted

Have I run out of disk or RAM? How can I trace this further?

Many thanks in advance!

Cheers,
David

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Unhandled Exception: No such id
parts:
David,

This was caused by an issue on the shinyapp.io servers. It should be fixed now. Please try deploying your app again. I recommend terminating your application first, and then deploying it, just to be safe:

terminateApp()
deployApp()

And for future communications, if you have an issue with shinyapps.io, please post it to this user group:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users 

Best,
Fereshteh
